newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian soldiers ill after drinking Moscow tap water.
newsitem.headline: Russian soldiers ill after drinking Moscow tap water.

text.p: About 70 soldiers in Moscow have been taken to hospital with hepatitis in the last four days after drinking tap water at their army base, a spokesman for the Moscow military district said on Friday.
"They have been hospitalised for several days now," the spokesman said, adding that the illness was not thought to be serious.
The incident was the latest in a serious of woes suffered by the beleaguered Russian armed forces, which are just a shadow of their Soviet-era might.
Because of widespread suspicions about the quality of water in the Russian capital, many Muscovites regularly boil their tap water. Sanitary officials insist that tap water is safe.
